[0] Apple is now rolling out new beta software for developers, including beta 3 versions of iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, and more.

[1] iPadOS 27.2 and other systems welcome beta 3

[2] A new round of beta versions is available for developers to test today, exactly two weeks since Apple's last release.

[3] iPadOS 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, and more are now rolling out beta 3.

[4] Key features in the 27.2 beta so far include:

  • [5] A new Health app, powered by Apple Intelligence
  • [6] Apple TV personalization settings coming to iPhone and iPad
  • [7] Siri AI brings Mac-style shortcuts to iPad
  • [8] Siri AI supports more languages

[9] This beta 3 update may add even more new features. If any are discovered, we'll keep reporting on them.

[10] Many unrevealed features may also be related to upcoming hardware. Sources indicate Apple will launch new home products, Macs, and more in the coming weeks.

[11] A public beta of beta 3 is not yet available, but is expected to be released within one to two days.

[12] Have you discovered any new features in iPadOS 27.2 beta 3 or other updates? Let us know in the comments.

[13] Best iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple TV accessories

  • [14] AirPods Pro 3 (now only $179, originally $249)
  • [15] Portable Apple Watch USB-C charger
  • [16] 100W USB-C fast charging power adapter
  • [17] Non-slip silicone Siri Remote case, compatible with AirTag
  • [18] HomeKit smart plug four-pack
